verifications.claim: The Masters Green Jacket has been awarded since 1949 to the Masters champion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Since the 1949 Masters, a green jacket ... has been awarded to the champion'; R4: 'That changed in 1949, when Sam Snead became the first Masters champion to be presented with a green jacket'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the green jacket tradition for winners began in 1949.

verifications.claim: The Masters Green Jacket has been worn by Augusta National members since 1937 to identify them to patrons.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Members first wore the jackets during the Masters in 1937 so patrons could easily identify them'; R4: 'By 1937, every Augusta member ... wore a green jacket so that patrons could easily identify them'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm 1937 introduction for members to distinguish from patrons.

verifications.claim: The Masters Green Jacket is an "Augusta Green" (Pantone 342C) wool blazer featuring an embroidered left-breast patch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'green jacket (specifically Pantone 342C, "Augusta Green")'; R4: 'single-breasted ... blazer ... embroidered Augusta National logo on the left breast pocket'; R6: 'embroidered patch ... on the left breast pocket'
verifications.reasoning: Direct matches on color, Pantone, blazer style, patch location; wool mentioned across sources.

verifications.claim: Masters Green Jacket winners may take the jacket home for one year before returning it to be stored on-site.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'must return it to the clubhouse one year after his victory'; R3: 'take home for a year ... Then it must be returned'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm one-year home retention before return to club.

verifications.claim: Masters Green Jacket winners return their jackets to the clubhouse 12 months after their victory.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'return it to the clubhouse one year after his victory'

verifications.claim: Masters Green Jacket winners' jackets are stored in a designated cloakroom.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: Exact match on storage in designated cloakroom.

verifications.claim: Masters Green Jacket winners' jackets are worn only while on the premises.

verifications.claim: Only a first-time and reigning Masters champion may remove his Green Jacket from the Augusta National club grounds.
